title: AI Governance Engineering: The Thesis & Body of Knowledge
description: The founding text and working reference for AI governance engineering: turning AI governance obligations into policy-as-code, eval gates and machine-readable evidence. Jorge García Aibar is the author of the Body of Knowledge, website, datasets and project materials. The Thesis is the sole exception and is co-authored by Jorge García Aibar and Aurélie Pols. Illustrative, not a claim of conformity.
